description: Creates an anonymous account with a zero balance and returns its API key, shown once. Only needed to upload an image before paying for anything (a Paid Visits ad needs an image or a video); otherwise use buy_ad_credit or create_ad, which create the account with the first payment. A video cannot be uploaded to an account made this way until it has been funded: for a video, start with buy_ad_credit.

idempotency_key.description: Only to REPEAT an earlier call of this tool (a lost answer, a payment still confirming): the idempotency_key that call returned. Leave it out for a new call; the server then makes a random one and returns it.

name: create_account
title: Create an empty account
